paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token
caption: Average performance on closed-book factual sentence completion benchmarks of models in terms of their parameter count. 70m to 2.8B are , while 7.0B is .
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the performance of models across a range of parameter sizes on closed-book factual sentence completion benchmarks. The x-axis is labeled “Model Size (log scale)” and spans from 70 million to 7.0 billion, with a logarithmic scale and tick labels at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis is labeled "Avg. Performance Size (%)" and ranges from 0% to 80%, with tick labels at 0%, 20%, 40%, 60%, and 80%. A red, solid line with triangular markers represents precision, starting at approximately 13% at 70m and decreasing to approximately 35% at 7.0B. A blue, solid line with triangular markers represents recall, starting at approximately 13% at 70m and increasing to approximately 36% at 7.0B. A purple, solid line with triangular markers represents F1-score, beginning at approximately 15% at 70m and rising to approximately 42% at 7.0B.
